model: ELM2 LED (Quantum twin-head emergency light, 120/277 V)
notes: Twin-head LED emergency light for 120/277 V with a 3.6 V nickel-cadmium battery; the HO option has a higher-output ni-cad pack and the SD option adds self-diagnostics. Whole-unit input from the sheet's primary circuit table: max 0.04 A at 120 V, 0.03 A at 277 V, 1.44 W (2.88 W with HO).

gaps: The sheet gives the battery as 3.6 V nickel-cadmium with no capacity and no part number.
ELB-B001 (3.6 V, 900 mAh NiCd) appears on a generic-brand Candela Corp listing and a Rexel listing; neither names the ELM2 LED, so the part number and the 900 mAh figure are left out.
Seller pages said to tie ELB-B001 to the ELM2 LED (build.com, HD Supply, PartsSource, Battery Mart, Battery Junction, Stokes Electric) gave 403, 429 or a certificate error, so none is cited.
The primary circuit table is the whole unit's input, not a charger rating, so it is in notes and not on the charger.
The sheet mentions a printed circuit board with an edge connector but names no board parts, so none are claimed.
The sheet prints the flame rating as UL94V-O; read as V-0.
method: Lithonia ELM2 LED Quantum thermoplastic emergency light spec sheet (Acuity Brands, Rev. 02/16/17, two pages), read from the Elliott Electric copy (file ELM2LEDM12-LIT-1021-1) with tools/research.js pdf; page 1 rendered and checked.
The Acuity Brands product page returned 403.
Candela Corp and Rexel replacement-battery listings read as text: they show a generic 3.6 V 900 mAh NiCd pack, with no compatibility list.

comps.spec: Sealed, maintenance-free nickel-cadmium battery, 3.6 V, 90-minute capacity to the emergency lamps; the HO option has a high-output ni-cad pack
Two LED lamp heads, each 1.5 W at 3.6 V with 12 white LEDs in series-parallel and a polycarbonate lens (3 W total)

Current-limiting charger with thermal compensation, regulated charge voltage, filtered input and two-state constant-current charge; AC/LVD reset and low-voltage disconnect guard against deep discharge
Low-profile test switch with an integrated pilot light; on SD (self-diagnostics) units pressing it starts a 30-second diagnostic test
Bright red status indicator, listed on the sheet with the integrated test switch/pilot light; the SD option has a single multi-colour LED indicator
White engineering-grade thermoplastic housing, UL 94 V-0 flame rating
No lead-acid pack; the battery is nickel-cadmium

sources.title: Lithonia ELM2 LED Quantum thermoplastic emergency light spec sheet, Rev. 02/16/17 (Acuity Brands; copy on Elliott Electric)
